full_name: Ann Pearson | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2009–2010 Physical Sciences Radcliffe Alumnae Fellow Harvard University
bio: Ann Pearson, a professor of biogeochemistry in the Department of Earth and Planetary Sciences at Harvard University, specializes in micro- and nanoscale analytical applications of light isotope geochemistry.
